sloka: त्वया ऽसकृद्विशस्त्रेण विशस्ता देवदानवाः।स सर्वायुधसम्पन्नो राघवं शास्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.६९.५ ।।
transliteration: tvayā 'sakṛdviśastreṇa viśastā devadānavāḥ।sa sarvāyudhasampanno rāghavaṁ śāstumarhasi ।। 6.69.5 ।।

translations.english: "Devas and Danavas have been won over by you, deprived of weapons also. Now endowed with all weapons you will be able to win Raghava."
